findings.text: blocking: when _expand returns None for every child (the failure judgement.py:246 documents as the call layer's report for a failed call, and the outcome a spent budget also produces), kept falls back to list(paths) and re-inserts the same interior node into the frontier, so _search_slot re-asks that node without bound; reproduced in a scratch copy with a stub returning None, which called decide_batch more than 200 times and never terminated for both physical_base and locus, so one routine call failure hangs the measurement run the plan dispatches next instead of narrowing the beam as the docstring at :451 promises.

follow-on: the recorded after_suite (and baseline_suite) command runs only tests/discovery/test_evaluation.py, tests/discovery/test_path_category_gate.py and tests/standard_names/test_judgment_goldens.py, so the tests/standard_names/test_segment_selection.py half of the brief's named gate is in neither arm and the added-failure count a reader derives from that pair says nothing about the new file; its only pass record is the head arm of negative_control.log (3 passed, EXIT=0).

follow-on: render_name composes with imas_standard_names.grammar.render.compose and then validates with parse(name, strict=True), re-implementing the compose-and-prove-canonical pair that imas_codex/standard_names/grammar_adapter.py:144 compose_canonical_ir owns and that imas_codex/standard_names/derivation.py:84 routes through, so a second module now decides what 'the grammar accepts' means.
follow-on: the slot-to-IR table's locus row opens with a duplicated tag '<tr><tr>', which puts the row outside its intended structure and will mis-nest for any table-aware renderer.
